name: Start of Combat
text: Triggers at the start of each combat.

name: Avenge
text: Triggers after a number of friendly minions die in the same combat.

name: Spellcraft
text: Gives a temporary spell when played and at the start of each recruit phase.

name: Venomous
text: The first minion it damages each combat is destroyed.

name: Trinket
text: Battlegrounds items bought for lasting bonuses.

name: Casts When Bought
text: Its effect happens when bought in the tavern.

name: Activate
text: Once per recruit turn, pay gold to use the effect.

name: Pass
text: Duos: give a card from your hand to your teammate (Claude inference from the cards that use it).

name: Deity
text: Randomly assigned; added to hand after three friendly aberrations die.

name: Buddy
text: A minion tied to your hero, earned or Discovered and added to your hand (Claude inference from the cards that use it).

name: Timewarp
text: A special shop visited on set turns where Chronum, a second currency that carries over, buys minions and spells (Claude inference from the cards that use it).

name: Bonus Keyword
text: Gains a random keyword (Divine Shield, Reborn, Stealth, Taunt, Venomous or Windfury).

name: Bounty
text: Tavern spells that appear only in lobbies with pirates.
